question: B03: Chọn cơ chế service authentication và guarded delivery cho transport Workspace-Knowledge.
selected_answer: Fixed Workspace gateway + Workspace-only authority + trusted TLS/service key + forwarded actor session + project-scoped RW guard (writer preference, revocation destroys sockets with deadline) + deny on ambiguous restart + no automatic failover
constraints: Delivery uses a shared reader lock; revocation/removal/authority changes use an exclusive writer lock.
Writer preference prevents revocation starvation under continuous streams.
Revocation sets a revoked flag, destroys affected sockets and waits for confirmed close until a bounded deadline; unconfirmed close is unknown.
New delivery re-checks the revoked flag before entering shared delivery.
Guard key is project-scoped; no document-plus-project lock ordering.
In-memory guard is lost on restart; fencing generation must be established before protected delivery resumes.
X-Service-Key is server-side, rotated and compared constant-time over trusted TLS.
X-Actor-Session is server-forwarded and never client/model authority.
Ambiguous restart or remote lifecycle state denies protected output; no automatic multi-authority failover.
